## Publication Information

**Date:** n.d. [September 1895]

**Genre:** Fiction (historical)

**Publisher:** London: National Society’s Depository, Broad Sanctuary, Westminster, New York: Thomas Whittaker, 2 & 3 Bible House.

**Notes:** This story, and its sequel <i>Founded on Paper</i> are set in rural Hampshire, starting in the early 1820s, at the time CMY’s parents settled in Otterbourne.
